title: Implement hardcoded admin login with fixed credentials and session persistence

requirements.summary: Redirect the user directly to '/admin/dashboard' immediately after successful admin login
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation to '/admin/dashboard' occurs automatically on login success
No intermediate pages or manual navigation is required
Redirect happens without delay or user interaction

file_operations.description: Update the admin login dialog to redirect to '/admin/dashboard' immediately upon successful authentication with the hardcoded credentials (ID: '919708075648', Password: '979142876085'). Remove any intermediate navigation steps and ensure the redirect happens automatically without user interaction. The component should verify the credentials match exactly before allowing access and performing the redirect.

requirements.summary: Fix any '404' or 'Access Denied' errors on the admin dashboard by ensuring proper routing configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard page loads successfully at '/admin/dashboard'
No 404 errors occur when accessing the dashboard route
No 'Access Denied' errors prevent viewing the dashboard content

file_operations.description: Verify that the '/admin/dashboard' route is properly configured in the TanStack Router setup. Ensure the route exists, is correctly mapped to the AdminPage component, and has no conflicting route definitions that could cause 404 errors. Add any missing route configurations needed for the admin dashboard to load successfully.

Review the AdminPage component to ensure it does not have any access control logic that could trigger 'Access Denied' errors after successful admin authentication. Verify that the component properly handles the authenticated admin state and displays the dashboard content without additional authorization checks that could block access.
